card.name: Potting soil and growing medium in gardening
card.fires_on: The word mix, soil, ting, medium or a comma right after potting, rich, plain or similar gardening words, in plant-growing advice. It predicts that the next word will be soil or a similar growing medium.

modes.label: Potting mix or soil
modes.description: The end of 'potting mix', 'potting soil' or 'potting medium' in container gardening advice.
modes.example: Add potting<< mix>>, not plain soil from your yard.

modes.label: Soil after a describing word
modes.description: The word soil or ground after an adjective like plain or rich, or just before one is expected.
modes.example: Add potting mix, not plain<< soil>> from your yard.

modes.label: Soil description lists
modes.description: A comma or word inside a list of soil qualities on a plant profile.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward saying soil or growing medium next, including in Chinese.
card.plain: It fires in gardening text when the next word is likely to be soil or growing mix.
